actions.value:
. /home/probe/session-env; set -eu; date -u +%FT%T.%N; out=/home/probe/evidence/mousekeys-state-before; mkdir -p "$out"; dpkg-query -W gsettings-desktop-schemas libglib2.0-0t64; schema=/usr/share/glib-2.0/schemas/org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard.gschema.xml; test -f "$schema"; sha256sum "$schema"; cat "$schema"; gsettings list-recursively org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard > "$out/keyboard-effective-settings.txt"; cat "$out/keyboard-effective-settings.txt"; for key in mousekeys-enable mousekeys-max-speed mousekeys-accel-time mousekeys-init-delay; do printf 'MOUSEKEYS_KEY=%s
' "$key"; gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard "$key" > "$out/$key.effective"; cat "$out/$key.effective"; gsettings range org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard "$key"; gsettings writable org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard "$key"; dconf read "/org/gnome/desktop/a11y/keyboard/$key" > "$out/$key.user-override"; printf 'USER_OVERRIDE_START=%s
' "$key"; cat "$out/$key.user-override"; printf 'USER_OVERRIDE_END=%s
' "$key"; done; timeout 15 /usr/bin/python3 /home/probe/source-input/geometry-oracle/snapshot-guest.py; printf 'MOUSEKEYS_STATE_BEFORE_COMPLETE
'
